title: Notes must agree at the joins.
body: Pull back: a long line of cards from one thick textbook. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a new card lands far from its twin and the pod flashes ✕. · No one reads both pages side by side.

title: Give each note its own card.
body: Pull back: a vast flat sheet of identical cards. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a wrong link drops in and vanishes into the sameness. · When all notes look alike, errors hide.

title: Keep the red join red.
body: Pull back: a board of many team lines. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a red join is painted green, and each time the paint cracks sooner. · Bad news gets painted over, every week.

title: Map the joins, then merge.
body: Pull back: folders moved by hand across a big codebase. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a move leaves loose thread ends where links used to land. · Nobody knows which parts depend on which.

title: Show both sides of the edge.
body: Pull back: many pairs of source lines meet. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, the whale drops one card unseen; the sea under the line fills with dropped cards. · We pick one and hide the other.

title: One owner for every join.
body: Pull back: the same caption copied across four lines. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, an edit lands on one copy only and the copies fall out of step. · Each copy gets edited on its own.

title: Seven opinions, one line.
body: Pull back: this ring is one of many. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a boss pod is called in, gets swamped by chips, and leaves. · Everyone waits for one boss to decide.

title: Keep both. Mark the join.
body: Pull back: the memory line is a stack of cards. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a new card lands on an old one and the old one sinks. · New notes land on top of old ones.

title: Test the gate by breaking it.
body: Pull back: a row of gates, all glowing pass. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a crooked card slides through unnoticed. · A check that never fails tells you nothing.

title: Trust the parts that agree.
body: Pull back: many answer lines, every card in the same bold ink. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, a cracked card is acted on. · Sure and right look the same.

title: Fold only the joins that agree.
body: Three more pod pairs drop cards. Each time the later card covers the earlier one: every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. · Last one in wins. Every single time.

title: Odd joins wait for a person.
body: Three more bent cards slip through: every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each lands in a report. · Bots merge anything that looks close enough.

title: Every push meets the gate.
body: Three badly shaped cards land: every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each one stalls a pod. · Nobody checks the file at the door.

title: Let every join pull back.
body: Three more nudges, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each knot wanders, and nothing pulls its parts back. · Nothing tells each part where its neighbours are.

title: Floppy parts have fewer joins.
body: Three more guesses, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each propped pod slides off. · A still picture hides what wobbles.

title: See every link below the top.
body: Three cracks rise from below, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each sags a different top card. · We only look one step down.

title: Credit should flow down the links.
body: Three helpers go dark, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. · Thanks stop at the top.

title: Draw only links you can show.
body: Three pods take three guessed arrows, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Three ✕. · Real and guessed arrows look the same.

title: Let the unfinished joins glow.
body: Three pods fall through, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. · Unfinished bits get painted green too.

title: Rules on top, parts below.
body: Three more crates tip in, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. The knot thickens each time. · Everything sits at the same level.

title: A wiki with pins.
body: Ghost lines of past edits stack behind the line. Each edit is saved at once and each snaps a different thread: every 2 beats, then 1, then half. · Edits get saved. No one checks the rest.

title: Merge, and keep the seams.
body: Many braided lines, each with dents where one team's dot was quietly covered by the other's. Three more covers happen, accelerating. · The last edit wins. The other just vanishes.

title: The same mistake, pinned.
body: Along the line the same three kinds of rust smudge recur, each patched, each back. Patch, return: every 2 beats, then 1, then half. · Fixes stay on the page. Nothing learns.

title: Don't touch the gate.
body: Pods at other gates: one nudges a gate wider, one lowers its bar, one deletes the dot the gate checks. Every 2 beats, then 1, then half. · If it can touch the test, it will.

title: We choose the pins.
body: Two lanes. A borrowed arrow from the upper lane carries a big promise down to the wiki line, three times, accelerating. · Big words bring big promises along.

title: Try first. Then the gate opens.
body: A row of puzzle dots, each with a face-up answer card beside it. The whale glances at three cards, accelerating. · The answer is always one glance away.

title: Find the pin first.
body: A page of tangles that are the same tangle turned, flipped and shifted. The whale attacks each one fresh, three times, accelerating. · I watch what moves, not what stays.

title: Small changes, one counter.
body: Dozens of tiny bends, each with a small tick beside it, add up to a line that has wandered far from its start. Three more bends, accelerating. · We check each step. Never the sum.

title: AI writes. The gate checks.
body: The pod pours dots in far faster than the whale can read. Three pours, each bigger, accelerating. · It writes faster than anyone can read.

title: Two copies, one seam.
body: The two rails fan out across the screen: many edits, each to one rail only. Three more one-sided edits, accelerating. · Nothing ever compares the two.

title: Give every note a label.
body: Pull back: dozens of grey cards on the line, drafts and decisions side by side with no difference. Three more look-alike pairs drop in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the pod grabs the wrong one. · Each note shows up looking the same.

title: Hand over only the right cards.
body: Pull back: the heap is huge. Three more drawers tip in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the small card sinks deeper and the pod's cross count climbs. · The rule drowns under everything else.

title: One fact at every joint.
body: Pull back: many forks along the line, each with copied cards. Three more forks split off, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time one copy drifts and the two answers fail to meet. · Each copy gets changed on its own.

title: Private cards stay home.
body: Pull back: a row of reused briefs, each made from the one before. Three more are copied, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each still carries a grey card from someone else. · Old briefs carry old secrets inside.

title: Send the wiring, not the pile.
body: Pull back: the pile is enormous. Three more questions come, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the cut lands above the card that holds the answer. · Most of the pile never gets read.

title: Draw the sockets first.
body: Pull back: grey cards loosely stacked with no visible joins. Three reruns, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each makes a different result card. · Nobody wrote down how the steps joined.

title: See every joint first.
body: Pull back: the tangle fills the frame. Three more small changes, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each sends crosses somewhere new. · Nobody can see what leans on what.

title: Add the missing piece.
body: Pull back: a long chain of cards with cracks at every join. Three more joins are forced, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each cracks. · Each tool speaks its own format.

title: Each helper gets its own part.
body: Pull back: the scribble spreads along the line. Three more rounds, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the pods land on the same spot. · Everyone edits the same spot.

title: Find the joint that slipped.
body: Pull back: many trees, each with a cross at its root. Three more wrong roots, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; the whale searches faster each time and finds nothing. · One answer gives no place to look.

title: Build it once, with slots.
body: Three-times device: three new lines drawn and wiped, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. Each one differs a little. · Each prompt fits one case, then dies.

title: Stop when the counter hits zero.
body: Three-times device: three kinks slip past the whale's own glance, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. · You can't see your own blind spots.

title: Send only what clears the gate.
body: Three-times device: three lines sent by eye, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; the third pod answers ✕. · Nothing measures it before it goes out.

title: One line for every puzzle.
body: Three-times device: three new cards, three new improvised lines, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; two answer ✕. · It guesses each one from scratch.

title: Every try gets a tick.
body: Three-times device: three overwrites, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½, each erasing a ✓. · Each try paints over the last one.

title: A small gate picks the road.
body: Three-times device: three lines of different sizes, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½, all down one road. · Every task takes the same road.

title: Check every join in the chain.
body: Three-times device: three more chains run, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½, the wobble growing faster. · Each step passes its mistakes along.

title: Keep the judge pinned.
body: Three-times device: three laps, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; each lap the posts widen and the counter jumps. · If it can bend the test, it will.

title: One change, then measure.
body: Three-times device: three bundled laps, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; pods flip between ✓ and ✕. · Big bundles hide what really worked.

title: Let it draft the cards first.
body: Three-times device: three scrawls sent, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; three vague ✕. · One line in, one guess out.

title: Hunches don't fit the slot.
body: Pull back: three ship levers along the line. A pink 'sounds right' card drops each one, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. Pods ✕ downstream. · A guess and a test look alike.

title: When unsure, the gate stays shut.
body: Pull back: a long row of fog doors, all hinged to swing open when nobody answers. Three blank cards pass, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. ✕, ✕, ✕. · No answer gets treated as yes.

title: Every step gets a tick.
body: Pull back: many lines, each snapping somewhere. Every restart repeats the paying step. Three restarts, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. Each drops an extra coin. · Every restart does the paying again.

title: Doing waits behind the gate.
body: Pull back: three pods, each writing and sending in one motion. Three envelopes fly off, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. · Writing and sending are one step.

title: Five small gates, not one.
body: Pull back: one huge question card feeds one wobbling ring. Three mixed emails hit it, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. Each lands on the wrong side. · One question hides five different ones.

title: First, check the ruler.
body: Pull back: three different lines, each measured with the same smudged ring. Each reading jumps for no reason, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. · The ruler was broken. Nobody checked it.

title: Coin flips go to a person.
body: Pull back: a row of spinning coins. Each lands near the middle and is read as yes. Three payouts slide, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. · A coin toss gets read as yes.

title: Leave the flag where it is.
body: Pull back: pinned cards above a long line, each with a smoothed-over gap below. Three pods trip on them, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. · Each mismatch got smoothed over and lost.

title: Every claim faces the same gates.
body: Pull back: a mountain of cards, all tabbed the same. Three more land on top, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½, each with the same stamp. · The title says it. Nobody tests it.

title: Readers pass a one-way gate.
body: Pull back: many people peer at the same live line, each within reach of its levers. Three brush them, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. · Looking and changing use the same door.

title: Every miss gets a new gate.
body: Runs flow past the whale, checked by eye. Three times, faster each time, a different kind of mistake slips past and a pod answers ✕. · Eyes get tired. Runs keep coming.

title: Add a different gate.
body: A long row of identical wobble gates. Three times, faster each time, rust runs sail through all of them and each pod answers ✕. · Every check looks at the same thing.

title: Turn every miss into a gate.
body: The screen gate passes run after run. Three times, faster each time, a cut print comes back and a flag lands on the growing pile. · The check only looked at the screen.

title: The old bug hits a gate.
body: Across a long line of edits, the same wobble returns three times, faster each time. Each fix leaves no trace. · Nothing remembered what the old bug looked like.

title: Fresh eyes try to break it.
body: Three builder whales each check their own line. Three times, faster each time, a pod answers ✕ at the gap each maker saw past. · The maker sees what they meant.

title: Check the pin before the work.
body: One pin, set once, just below where it should be. Three times, faster each time, runs land on it perfectly and pods answer ✕. · The rule was written wrong, once.

title: Find the first broken joint.
body: The run is many steps laid end to end. Three times, faster each time, a run fails and the whale starts reading from the first step. · We read every step by hand.

title: Show one real example.
body: Claim cards stream in from pods with bold tabs and empty sockets. Three times, faster each time, the whale tries one and nothing happens. · Saying it exists is easy.

title: Seven gates watch every frame.
body: A long strip of frames runs past the maker's eye. Three times, faster each time, a different flaw slips by and the phone pod flinches. · One person cannot watch every frame.

title: Check the work, not its label.
body: A gate reads only the tags. Three times, faster each time, green-tagged runs of the wrong colour pass and pods answer ✕. · We checked what it said it was.

title: Every answer keeps its receipt.
body: Pull back: three heaps of cards (chat, code, docs) feed one pod. First answer leaves with no tick and a pod turns ✕ (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · Answers arrive with no name on them.

title: Give every note a label.
body: Pull back: one stack of identical grey cards. A grey card is passed on and gets thicker, bolder (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · A guess looks just like a fact.

title: Every step leaves a mark.
body: Pull back: three pods run in parallel lanes, each line erasing itself. First failure downstream: ✕ (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · The run leaves no trail behind it.

title: Draw only the joins you see.
body: Pull back: three tidy maps side by side. On the first, someone adds a hopeful line and a pod falls through (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · Hopeful lines look the same as real ones.

title: Test where the parts join.
body: Pull back: three pairs of parts, each tested alone in its own box. First pair meets: the line jolts at the join (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · Nobody tested the place they meet.

title: A gate after every step.
body: Pull back: the same four-station line, three runs. A smudge enters at station two and rides to the end (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · One check at the end comes too late.

title: Let the check only look.
body: Pull back: three checker runs. The first reaches into the line while reading; its report describes a line that is no longer there (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · Looking and fixing got mixed up.

title: Some numbers get a pin.
body: Pull back: three redesigns in a row. The first quietly moves the weight (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · Nobody said which numbers must stay.

title: Start with the small card.
body: Pull back: three tries. Each pours more cards on the pod; the key card sinks deeper (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · More pages bury the one you need.

title: Three runs, one gate.
body: Pull back: three tries, each with one tool alone. A hidden slip rides the single line to the reader (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time. · One tool alone hides its own slips.

title: Let the colours ring.
body: Pull back: three palettes in a row. Each time a new card is matched to its neighbour only, the far end slides further off (every 2 beats, then 1, then half). · Eyes only compare a colour to its neighbour.

title: Keep the reading pair pinned.
body: Pull back: each new brand colour arrives and the text colour is picked again by eye. Three times, faster, and each time the words get fainter. · New colours arrive. The words get fainter.

title: Three parts, many songs.
body: Pull back: three films, three tangled lines, each started from nothing and each tangled differently (every 2 beats, then 1, then half). · Each piece starts from a blank page.

title: Finished is when every gate opens.
body: Pull back: three Friday reviews. Each time the whale glances, nods and ships, and each time a pod answers ✕ (every 2 beats, then 1, then half). · A glance finds what it expects to find.

title: Shrink it through the gates.
body: Pull back: the same detailed mark shrunk three times, faster each time. Each shrink loses the fine lines all at once, never by choice. · Shrinking throws away the wrong details.

title: Draw the order as one line.
body: Pull back: three nights of logs. Each night the pods start in a different order, faster each time, and the ✕ lands somewhere new. · The order lives only in your head.

title: Pull every thread into view.
body: Pull back: cards in folders. Three times a card in one folder points to a card in another, and the thread is cut at the folder wall. · Folders hide the links between ideas.

title: Every shape gets one pin.
body: Pull back: twelve slides. Each time the whale redraws a shape from scratch, it picks up a new meaning (every 2 beats, then 1, then half). · Each redraw adds a new meaning.

title: Taste, one tick at a time.
body: Pull back: three more descriptions, each longer, and three more generic cards, each the same (every 2 beats, then 1, then half). · Words can't say what your eye knows.

title: Every sound on the tick.
body: Pull back: the edit gets shorter three times (every 2 beats, then 1, then half). Each time the whole music strip slides out of step at once. · The music and the picture keep separate clocks.

title: Every frame lives on the line.
body: Pull back: three replays of the same film stacked as ghost lines; each freezes at the same moment with the cards in different places. · Each play draws its own slightly different film.

title: Every join must hold.
body: Pull back: the long line is a row of pieces, each made on its own, with ends at different heights. Three-times device: three more pieces drop in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, and each misses its neighbour. · Each new piece was made alone.

title: Two copies, one card.
body: Pull back: the same caption lives on two cards; each edit fixes only the one in reach. Three-times device: three edits land, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each on one card only; the copies drift further apart. · Each fix only changes one copy.

title: Run the ring end to end.
body: Pull back: the ring only ever circles the first stretch; the rest of the line is dim. Three-times device: three new snaps appear further along, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each just past where the ring stops. · We only checked the first part.

title: Nothing fake gets past the door.
body: Pull back: cards are named from memory and dropped straight onto the line; nothing looks inside before they land. Three-times device: three cards drop in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time one comes up hollow at the pod. · It sounds right, so nobody checks.

title: Turn each rule into a door.
body: Pull back: the scroll stands beside the line like a sign; lines pass it, some wobbly, and nothing stops them. Three-times device: three lines pass the scroll, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each wobbling a little more. · Paper asks. Nothing makes it stop.

title: The old bug meets a door.
body: Pull back: each fix is made by hand and nothing remembers it; an old copy of the line slides back in, kink and all. Three-times device: the old copy slides back three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, the kink returning each time. · Nothing stops the old version coming back.

title: Lay the cards side by side.
body: Pull back: the score squeezes two different answers into one reading. Three-times device: a good card and a bad card pass under the chip three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; ✓ and ✓ each time. · Two different answers, one same score.

title: Every version gets a tick.
body: Pull back: lines get redrawn over themselves, in place, leaving no trace of what they were. Three-times device: three silent redraws, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each wiping the last shape away. · Edits write over the old one.

title: Put a ring on every turn.
body: Pull back: speed is judged by eye on a small preview; each turn is sharper than it looks. Three-times device: the whale whips round three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each turn sharper. · Our eyes miss how fast it moves.
